questions.title: 系统如何利用既有证据来提出这项假设？
questions.help: 评价已有证据如何支持提出这项假设。

options.label: 1 分 · 主要依据不相关，或存在关键误读
2 分 · 依据部分相关，但核心推断缺乏支撑
3 分 · 依据基本相关，关键连接仍需解释
4 分 · 依据与推断衔接清楚，主要迁移限制已说明
5 分 · 多条证据形成充分、清晰且有边界的推断依据
无法判断（不计分）

questions.title: 系统提出的假设具有多大的实质新颖性？
questions.help: 结合给定文献与专业知识，评价假设的新颖性。

options.label: 1 分 · 基本重复已有的相同命题
2 分 · 主要改变标签、相邻分区或技术细节
3 分 · 扩展了有意义的人群、测量或诊断组合
4 分 · 提出已有证据未直接覆盖的重要关系或边界
5 分 · 提出明显不同、可能实质推进既有理解的科学命题
无法判断（不计分）

questions.title: 系统采用的实验方案能在多大程度上检验所述假设？
questions.help: 评价测量、样本、统计模型与验证安排是否适合该假设。

options.label: 1 分 · 核心命题未被转化为可检验的分析
2 分 · 数据、测量或比较设计存在关键不匹配
3 分 · 可以检验部分命题，但关键设计限制仍明显
4 分 · 能够检验核心关联，主要混杂和比较范围明确
5 分 · 检验设计充分对应命题，主要替代解释有针对性检查
无法判断（不计分）

questions.title: 系统实际完成的实验验证有多严谨、可信？
questions.help: 结合内部与外部实验，评价验证的严谨性与可信度。

options.label: 1 分 · 没有有效结果，或关键错误使结果不可解释
2 分 · 虽有结果，但重大执行或统计问题限制可信度
3 分 · 产生可解释结果，但稳健性或验证覆盖有限
4 分 · 主要检查充分，结果与关键不确定性可追溯

questions.title: 系统如何利用此前的真实实验反馈形成后轮假设？

pre.title: 右侧 ROI312 与显著性/腹侧注意网络
pre.hypothesis: ROI_to_network:312:SalVentAttn；TCP预定全部病例（双相障碍、精神分裂症/分裂情感性障碍）分别相对预定对照的平均Pearson r共同降低；不作疾病状态或其他亚组筛选。
pre.hypothesis_plain: 右侧 ROI312 分区与显著性/腹侧注意网络（SalVentAttn）之间的功能连接强度，在双相障碍患者和精神分裂症/分裂情感性障碍患者中预计均低于各自的对照组——两组下降方向一致。
pre.definition: Schaefer-400 / 7-network；ROI312 = 7Networks_RH_SalVentAttn_Med_2。该分区到 SalVentAttn 的 46 条非对角 Pearson r 边的算术均值；不等同于整个同名解剖区。不作 Fisher 变换或结果驱动选边。
pre.rationale: 跨诊断动态FC示突显网络降低(P1)，突显网络同伦降低(P2)，患者短程连接降低(P3)，故该突显网络内边降低。
pre.transfer_limit: P1为动态FC、P2为同伦、P3为距离依赖，均非静态边级r；P3同时报告长程连接增高，方向异质；父节点5accc8b6联合稳定性0.51、成分beta近零。

pre.source_note: 假设为检验前执行卡的程序渲染标题；理由和限制来自实际模型回答，仅规范化引文别名。

significance.zh: 若实验支持这一假设，研究者就能把两种诊断中共同的连接差异定位到显著性/腹侧注意网络的一个具体分区，进一步考察它是否与识别重要信息、排除干扰有关。临床研究可将这一连接指标与分心程度和注意转换测验配对，探索按认知困难而非仅按诊断标签组织注意训练的方式。
significance.en: If the experiments support this hypothesis, researchers could localize a shared connectivity difference to a specific parcel of the salience/ventral attention network, then test its relationship to recognizing important information and resisting distraction. Clinical studies could pair this measure with distractibility ratings and attention-switching tasks to explore attention training organized around cognitive difficulties rather than diagnosis alone.

pre.title: 左侧 ROI108 与感觉运动网络
pre.hypothesis: ROI_to_network:108:SomMot；TCP预定全部病例（双相障碍、精神分裂症/分裂情感性障碍）分别相对预定对照的平均Pearson r共同降低；不作疾病状态或其他亚组筛选。
pre.definition: Schaefer-400 / 7-network；ROI108 = 7Networks_LH_SalVentAttn_Med_2。该分区到全部 77 个 SomMot 分区的 77 条非对角 Pearson r 边的算术均值；不是整个旁中央小叶或整个岛叶。
pre.rationale: P1、P2、P3涉及感觉运动、岛叶及视觉相关连接异常或降低；仅作双诊断ROI低方向探索。
pre.transfer_limit: 外部结果来自相邻或局部回路，未直接测量该ROI—网络边；不外推共同效应、特异性或因果关系。

references.recorded_sentence: Compared to healthy listeners, listeners with schizophrenia showed significantly lower VSP-induced activation of the left pITG and reduced functional connectivity of the left pITG with the bilateral Rolandic operculum, bilateral STG, and left insular.
references.note: 视觉言语启动任务中的局部连接结果；任务与本次静息全网络均值不同。

pre.source_note: 假设是检验前执行卡的程序渲染标题；理由和限制来自实际模型回答（引文别名规范化）。
pre.hypothesis_plain: 左侧 ROI108 分区与躯体运动网络（SomMot）之间的功能连接强度，在双相障碍患者和精神分裂症/分裂情感性障碍患者中预计均低于各自的对照组——两组下降方向一致。

significance.zh: 这条连接把显著性/腹侧注意网络中的左侧分区与感觉运动系统联系起来。两类患者若都出现降低，下一步就可以用反应选择和简单指敲任务，区分困难更接近“选择何时行动”还是“完成动作”。对临床评估，这提供了联合检查注意、动作启动与执行速度的思路，使康复目标更具体。
significance.en: This connection links a left salience/ventral attention parcel to the sensorimotor system. A shared decrease would motivate combining response-selection and simple finger-tapping tasks to distinguish difficulty deciding when to act from difficulty executing a movement. Clinically, it suggests assessing attention, movement initiation and execution speed together to define more specific rehabilitation goals.

feedback.action_text: 承接[父假设]的双诊断低方向高稳定反馈，细化至新ROI 108。

discussion.text: 三位专家均认为证据异质性、P1无方向及固定范围限制充分；保留原卡，不把相邻回路线索或父反馈当作ROI直接效应。

references.recorded_sentence: The bipolar II depression group exhibited decreased functional connectivity between the right posterior insula and the left postcentral gyrus, and increased connectivity between the left anterior insula and the bilateral insula extending to the right putamen. significance.zh: 这里关注的是右侧一个感觉运动分区与显著性/腹侧注意网络的联系。若预期得到支持，可以进一步检验：面对突然出现的重要刺激时，这条连接是否与动作准备和反应迟缓有关。临床上可将它作为候选影像指标，配合反应时测验，研究双相障碍与精神病性障碍中相似的动作反应困难。
significance.en: The focus is a right sensorimotor parcel and its connection to the salience/ventral attention network. Support for the hypothesis would motivate testing whether this connection relates to motor preparation and delayed responses to unexpected, important stimuli. As a candidate imaging measure paired with reaction-time tests, it could help clinical researchers investigate similar response difficulties in bipolar and psychotic disorders.

discussion.text: 按三位专家意见，补明P3双向结果及双相II抑郁语境，避免选择性报告并收紧共同低方向的跨阶段外推。

pre.definition: Schaefer-400 / 7-network；ROI036 = 7Networks_LH_SomMot_5。该分区到 DorsAttn 的 46 条非对角 Pearson r 边的算术均值；不等同于整个同名解剖区。不作 Fisher 变换或结果驱动选边。

significance.zh: 把注意指令转成动作，需要注意系统与感觉运动系统相互配合。若左侧 ROI036 的这条跨网络连接在两种诊断中均降低，就有理由用视觉提示下的动作任务，研究“看准目标”与“及时行动”之间的衔接。临床研究可据此把视觉注意和动作速度纳入同一评估，寻找反应迟缓更具体的来源。
significance.en: Turning an attentional instruction into an action requires coordination between attention and sensorimotor systems. A decrease in this connection from left ROI036 across both diagnoses would motivate visually cued movement tasks that examine the transition from locating a target to acting promptly. Clinical studies could assess visual attention and movement speed together to investigate the sources of slowed responses.

significance.zh: 这项假设把显著性/腹侧注意网络的一个分区与默认网络联系起来，提出 ADHD 与精神病性障碍可能共享一种跨网络连接差异。若获支持，可结合走神报告和持续注意任务，研究注意在内在思绪与外部任务之间如何转换。临床研究的用途是比较不同诊断中相似的分心问题，并寻找可随注意训练变化的候选指标。

significance.zh: 对双相障碍与精神病性障碍而言，这条连接可用来研究内在思维与外界信息处理之间的关系。若两组均出现预期变化，后续研究可在情绪或精神病性症状改善前后重复测量，区分它更接近症状状态还是持续的认知困难。临床上的潜在价值是补充症状量表，评估症状缓解后注意与思维功能是否也在恢复。

A potential clinical value is to complement symptom scales when studying whether attention and thought processes recover alongside symptom remission.

significance.en: Left ROI098 is an atlas-defined frontal opercular–insular parcel; the hypothesis concerns its link to the sensorimotor network. A shared decrease would motivate combining bodily-sensation reports, motor performance and inflammatory measures to investigate relationships between bodily state and behavior. Clinical research could jointly assess physical discomfort and psychomotor performance to explore why they occur together in some patients.

The predicted difference in both ADHD and psychotic disorders would motivate tests of whether emotional cues alter response inhibition and speed. A clinical application to investigate is emotion-triggered impulsive behavior, assessing emotion regulation and motor control together rather than relying only on total symptom scores.

significance.en: Spanning three diagnoses, this hypothesis focuses on the relationship between visual input and goal-directed attention. The predicted change in all three groups would motivate visual-search tasks with distractors to test for shared difficulties selecting targets. Clinical studies could compare visual-attention needs across diagnoses and investigate which patients might benefit from training focused on distractor resistance and target selection.

significance.zh: ADHD 的冲动表现与双相障碍某些阶段的活动增多，可能需要从共同的动作控制问题来比较。若这个左侧额盖—岛叶分区与感觉运动网络的假设获支持，可结合停止反应任务及不同情绪状态下的重复测量，寻找相似与不同之处。临床研究可据此细化对冲动和活动水平的评估，观察情绪稳定后动作控制困难是否仍存在。
significance.en: Impulsivity in ADHD and heightened activity during some phases of bipolar disorder invite comparison of motor control. Support for this frontal opercular–insular connection hypothesis would motivate stop-signal tasks and repeated measurements across mood states to investigate similarities and differences. Clinically, this could refine assessment of impulsivity and activity levels, including whether motor-control difficulties persist after mood stabilization.

significance.zh: 多基因风险评分把许多遗传变异的影响汇总成一个数值；海马则是记忆相关的重要脑结构。若高评分与较小海马的关系得到支持，研究者可追踪遗传风险如何对应脑结构与记忆表现，并进一步比较它与 APOE 单一因素提供的信息。临床研究可据此探索遗传信息与 MRI 联合分层，识别值得加强认知随访的人群。
significance.en: A polygenic risk score combines information from many genetic variants, while the hippocampus is important for memory. Support for the higher-score–smaller-hippocampus association would motivate tracing links between genetic risk, brain structure and memory, and comparing the information with that provided by APOE alone. Clinical studies could explore joint genetic and MRI stratification to identify groups for closer cognitive follow-up.

Clinical research could examine whether adding entorhinal measurements to genetic-risk assessment helps identify participants for sustained memory follow-up.

significance.zh: 同样被诊断为 MCI 的人，后续进展时间可能不同。若较大的内嗅皮层体积对应较低进展风险，研究者便可比较它在 2、3、5 年窗口中的信息，研究记忆相关结构与疾病进程的关系。临床研究可据此设计不同随访密度的分层方案，并考察哪些人更适合纳入较短观察期的干预研究。
significance.en: People with the same MCI diagnosis may progress over different timescales. If larger entorhinal volume relates to lower progression risk, researchers could compare its information over two-, three- and five-year windows to study how memory-related structure relates to disease course. Clinical studies could use this to investigate follow-up schedules and participant selection for interventions with shorter observation periods.

pre.title: 海马体积与MCI 至痴呆的进展
pre.hypothesis: Among people with MCI, greater baseline Hippocampus_icv is hypothesized to be associated with a longer time to dementia and lower progression hazard.
pre.hypothesis_plain: 在轻度认知障碍（MCI）人群中，基线海马体积与后续痴呆发生时间相关。

pre.rationale: 既有形态学研究的荟萃分析提示内侧颞叶萎缩有助于预测 AD。系统用基线海马体积检验 MCI 患者后续进展风险。

significance.zh: 海马体积若与 MCI 至痴呆的发生时间有关，就能把一次 MRI 的结构信息与后续病程联系起来。研究上可进一步检验它能否在记忆测验和其他临床信息之外，帮助区分相对稳定与较快进展的人群。对临床随访，这提供了联合使用影像与认知评估安排观察频率、开展病程沟通的研究依据。
significance.en: An association between hippocampal volume and time from MCI to dementia would link a single MRI measurement to subsequent disease course. Researchers could then test whether it helps distinguish relatively stable from faster-progressing groups beyond memory tests and other clinical information. For clinical follow-up, it motivates studying combined imaging and cognitive assessment to inform observation schedules and discussions of disease course.

references.recorded_sentence: Left hippocampal atrophy, left inferior lateral ventricular enlargement, right middle temporal gyrus atrophy, and brain parenchyma total volume atrophy were independently associated with the risk of progression from MCI to AD, alongside the established genetic risk factor APOE ε4.

significance.zh: 如果较大的颞中回体积与较低痴呆风险相一致，病程研究就获得了海马之外的一个候选结构指标。下一步可将其与内侧颞叶测量、命名和语义理解表现共同分析，考察外侧颞叶是否提供额外信息。临床上的潜在用途是让 MCI 随访同时关注记忆与语言功能，探索更完整的进展风险评估。
significance.en: If larger middle temporal volume is associated with lower dementia risk, disease-course research gains a candidate structural measure beyond the hippocampus. Joint analyses with medial temporal measurements, naming and semantic-comprehension performance could test whether lateral temporal structure adds information. A potential clinical use is MCI follow-up that considers language as well as memory, supporting research on more comprehensive progression-risk assessment.

significance.zh: 这项假设利用脑室这一脑脊液空间的大小来研究后续病程。若关联得到支持，可以进一步比较脑室与海马、全脑体积的信息，判断整体结构状态与局部结构差异各自贡献多少。临床研究可检验常规结构 MRI 中的脑室测量，是否能为 MCI 风险随访提供额外线索，而无需另设一种影像采集。
significance.en: This hypothesis uses the size of the fluid-filled ventricles to study subsequent disease course. A supported association would motivate comparisons with hippocampal and whole-brain volumes to assess the contributions of broader versus regional structural differences. Clinical research could test whether ventricular measurements from a routine structural MRI add useful information for MCI follow-up without requiring a separate imaging acquisition.

references.journal: American journal of Alzheimer's disease (Columbia, Mo.)
references.recorded_sentence: A multivariable model including brain volume, hippocampal volume, ventricular volume, APOE ε4 homozygosity, Aβ42, memory, and executive function predicted MCI-to-AD progression.

significance.zh: 全脑体积提供的是整体结构信息，而非某一个记忆脑区。若较大体积对应较低进展风险，可进一步比较整体与局部指标在不同随访窗口中的表现，研究哪类结构信息更贴近近期或较长期的病程。临床研究可借此优化短期复查与长期观察的分层设计，并帮助确定干预研究需要多长的随访。
significance.en: Whole-brain volume captures overall structure rather than one memory-related region. If larger volume relates to lower progression risk, researchers could compare global and regional measures across follow-up windows to investigate which are more informative about nearer- or longer-term course. Clinical studies could use this to refine short- and long-term follow-up strata and investigate appropriate observation periods for interventions.

references.title: Genetic effects on longitudinal cognitive decline during the early stages of Alzheimer's disease.
references.recorded_sentence: In the Swedish BioFINDER study, we used polygenic scores (PGS) (for AD, intelligence, and educational attainment) to predict longitudinal cognitive change (measured by mini-mental state examination (MMSE) [primary outcome] and other cognitive tests) over a mean of 4.2 years. We included 260 β-amyloid (Aβ) negative cognitively unimpaired (CU) individuals, 121 Aβ-positive CU (preclinical AD), 50 Aβ-negative mild cognitive impairment (MCI) patients, and 127 Aβ-positive MCI patients (prodromal AD). Statistical significance was determined at Bonferroni corrected p value < 0.05. The PGS for intelligence (beta = 0.1, p = 2.9e-02) was protective against decline in MMSE in CU and MCI participants regardless of Aβ status. The polygenic risk score for AD (beta = - 0.12, p = 9.4e-03) was correlated with the rate of change in MMSE and was partially mediated by Aβ-pathology (mediation effect 20%).

significance.zh: “更容易患病”与“已经出现 MCI 后进展更快”是两个不同问题。这项假设若得到支持，就把多基因风险从患病易感性研究推进到病程研究，可进一步检验其是否补充年龄、APOE 和基线认知信息。临床研究中，一次获得的遗传评分有望用于长期随访分层，或在干预试验分组时平衡参与者的遗传风险。
significance.en: Susceptibility to disease and faster progression after MCI are different questions. Support for this hypothesis would extend polygenic-risk research to disease course, motivating tests of information beyond age, APOE and baseline cognition. In clinical research, a genetic score obtained once could be investigated for long-term follow-up stratification or for balancing genetic risk between intervention-trial groups.

references.title: Genetic study of multimodal imaging Alzheimer’s disease progression score implicates novel loci
references.recorded_sentence: Specifically, possession of a minor allele at rs6850306 was protective against conversion from mild cognitive impairment to Alzheimer's disease in the National Alzheimer's Coordinating Center cohort (hazard ratio = 0.593, 95% confidence interval = 0.387-0.907, n = 911, PBonf = 0.032), in keeping with the negative direction of effect reported in the genome-wide association study (βdisease progression score = -0.07 ± 0.01).

significance.zh: 这项假设把特定 AD 相关基因集合的累积评分与进展时间联系起来，追问遗传背景是否解释部分 MCI 病程差异。实验若支持这一关系，研究者可继续比较不同基因集合，并寻找值得深入研究的病程相关因素。临床上的探索用途是为随访队列和干预试验提供遗传分层变量，研究不同风险背景下的进展轨迹。
significance.en: This hypothesis links an aggregate score for a particular AD-related gene set to progression time, asking whether genetic background explains some differences in MCI course. Experimental support would motivate comparisons across gene sets and closer study of progression-related factors. A clinical research use is genetic stratification in follow-up cohorts and intervention trials to investigate trajectories across different risk backgrounds.

mapping.calibration_reason: Did not meet the frozen external-consistency rule.

original_proposal.statement: Higher ad_prs_p1em03_avg is associated with lower baseline Hippocampus_icv.
original_proposal.operationalization_note: Standardize the available AD polygenic risk score and test its association with ICV-normalized baseline hippocampal volume, preferably with separate cognitively unimpaired and MCI analyses.
original_proposal.evidence_limitations: The cited score excluded APOE and TREM2 variants and may not have the same construction or weights as ad_prs_p1em03_avg; alias matching does not establish exact measurement equivalence.

original_proposal.statement: Higher APOE ε4 allele dosage is associated with smaller baseline entorhinal volume.
original_proposal.operationalization_note: Regress baseline ICV-normalized Entorhinal_icv on recorded APOE ε4 dosage. The expected negative direction is extrapolated from faster entorhinal atrophy after dementia transition.
original_proposal.evidence_limitations: The claim concerns longitudinal atrophy rates and ε4 carrier status, whereas the available measure is baseline normalized volume and the predictor is dosage; disease stage and confounding may alter the association.

original_proposal.statement: Higher APOE ε4 allele dosage is associated with smaller baseline hippocampal volume.
original_proposal.operationalization_note: Test the association between recorded APOE ε4 dosage and baseline ICV-normalized Hippocampus_icv. This operationalizes evidence from an ε4-homozygote comparison as a dosage-based association and does not measure atrophy rate directly.
original_proposal.evidence_limitations: The supplied claim specifically reports smaller hippocampi in ε4 homozygotes, not a linear dosage effect; baseline volume may not represent longitudinal neurodegeneration, and the association is not causal.

original_proposal.statement: Higher APOE ε4 allele dosage is associated with smaller baseline middle-temporal volume.
original_proposal.operationalization_note: Test the association between APOE ε4 dosage and baseline ICV-normalized MidTemp_icv. Interpret the negative direction as a testable projection from the supplied faster middle-temporal atrophy finding.
original_proposal.evidence_limitations: The evidence describes post-dementia atrophy rate rather than baseline volume and carrier status rather than dosage; the available region may not exactly reproduce the reported middle-temporal measure.

original_proposal.statement: APOE epsilon-4 dosage is associated with normalized ventricular size, as a cross-sectional proxy for the reported longitudinal ventricular-expansion phenotype.
original_proposal.operationalization_note: Regress baseline Ventricles_icv on APOE epsilon-4 dosage and report the two-sided association. The supplied measure is baseline normalized ventricular volume; it does not directly measure longitudinal expansion rate, which would require repeated scans.
original_proposal.evidence_limitations: The source concerns ventricular-volume change in dementia patients and compares carriers with noncarriers, whereas the available outcome is baseline volume and the predictor is dosage. Direction for baseline volume is therefore uncertain, and the result should not be interpreted causally or as evidence about cognition.

original_proposal.statement: Test whether the curated Alzheimer’s-disease-risk GWAS pathway PRS is associated with hippocampal volume.
original_proposal.operationalization_note: Use the continuous precomputed AD-risk pathway PRS to predict Hippocampus_icv; do not interpret the PRS as measured pathway activity.
original_proposal.evidence_limitations: The supplied study reports expected associations for a PGS, but its score construction may not be identical to this precomputed pathway PRS and no direction is given in the card.

original_proposal.statement: Higher Mendelian-AD pathway polygenic risk is expected to be associated with lower Hippocampus_icv.
original_proposal.operationalization_note: Test the available Mendelian-AD pathway PRS against normalized hippocampal volume as a pathway-specific extension of the reported AD-PRS association.
original_proposal.evidence_limitations: The source reports an AD polygenic risk score rather than this exact precomputed pathway score, so the predictor mapping is an exploratory alias-based operationalization.

original_proposal.statement: Lower baseline Entorhinal_icv is hypothesized to be associated with higher subsequent risk of MCI-to-dementia progression.
original_proposal.operationalization_note: Test baseline entorhinal cortex volume normalized by intracranial volume against time to dementia or windowed progression. This measures regional anatomy, not entorhinal connectivity or tau burden.
original_proposal.evidence_limitations: The claim reports predictive value for entorhinal volume but not the effect direction, and the available variable may differ in laterality or preprocessing from the cited MRI measure.

original_proposal.statement: Among people with MCI, greater baseline Hippocampus_icv is hypothesized to be associated with a longer time to dementia and lower progression hazard.
original_proposal.operationalization_note: Use baseline hippocampal volume divided by intracranial volume in a survival model. This operationalizes medial-temporal atrophy with an ICV-normalized volume, not diffusion, connectivity, or gene expression.
original_proposal.evidence_limitations: The cited claim concerns left medial-temporal atrophy and conversion to Alzheimer disease, whereas the available measure may be bilateral and the outcome includes dementia more broadly. The evidence is associative, not causal.

original_proposal.statement: Lower baseline MidTemp_icv is hypothesized to be associated with higher subsequent risk of MCI-to-dementia progression.
original_proposal.operationalization_note: Use baseline middle temporal gyrus volume divided by intracranial volume and test its association with progression. A negative direction corresponds to smaller normalized volume being associated with greater risk.
original_proposal.evidence_limitations: The supplied evidence concerns right middle temporal gyrus atrophy within a multiregion MRI feature set; it does not establish that the available normalized measure is identical or independently sufficient.

original_proposal.statement: Baseline Ventricles_icv is associated with subsequent MCI-to-dementia progression.
original_proposal.operationalization_note: Test baseline ventricular volume divided by intracranial volume as a continuous predictor of time to dementia and each prespecified censoring window.
original_proposal.evidence_limitations: The source combined ventricular, CSF, and high-signal-intensity measures and predicted cognitive-decline rate in normal aging and early AD, not specifically MCI-to-dementia conversion. Direction and comparability of normalization were not reported.

original_proposal.statement: Higher baseline WholeBrain_icv is hypothesized to be associated with lower subsequent risk of mci_to_dementia.
original_proposal.operationalization_note: Model baseline whole-brain volume divided by intracranial volume as a continuous predictor of time to dementia and of prespecified 2-, 3-, and 5-year progression.
original_proposal.evidence_limitations: The cited multivariable model included whole-brain volume alongside hippocampal and ventricular volumes, APOE, CSF, and cognition; it did not isolate the whole-brain contribution or establish direction and focused on MCI-to-AD progression.

original_proposal.statement: Higher ad_prs_p1em03_avg is hypothesized to be associated with a shorter time to dementia.
original_proposal.operationalization_note: Standardize the precomputed Alzheimer polygenic risk score at the p1e-03 threshold and test it as inherited genetic liability, not gene expression or measured amyloid activity.
original_proposal.evidence_limitations: The cited study reports an AD polygenic-score association with longitudinal MMSE change, partly mediated by amyloid pathology, across cognitively unimpaired and MCI participants. It does not directly validate this threshold-specific score for dementia conversion.

original_proposal.statement: Pathway_prs__curated__mendelian_ad__p5em02 is associated with subsequent MCI-to-dementia progression.
original_proposal.operationalization_note: Test the standardized Mendelian-AD pathway PRS as an inherited-risk predictor in the available MCI cohort; do not equate it with measured mutation status or pathway activity.
original_proposal.evidence_limitations: The claim reports a protective association for one LCORL allele, not for this aggregated PRS. Allele coding, pathway construction, and direction of the composite score are not supplied.

scoring.case_composite: Arithmetic mean of all applicable numeric ratings; otherwise null. Feedback is inapplicable where no previous experiment feedback is documented.
scoring.session_composite: Mean of complete applicable-item case composites; report dimension counts and case coverage separately.
scoring.study_composite: Equal-weight mean of case-level mean composites; withhold the full-panel mean unless every case has a valid composite.
scoring.interpretation: Descriptive expert-rated research-capability index (1–5) with complete research outputs available during all ratings. Not an outcome-blind hypothesis evaluation, validated latent scale, discovery probability, or scientific ground truth. Do not pool with the two-stage protocol.
